title: The dispatcher
text:
The dispatcher. Mira Hollowell has spent twenty years making trucks arrive on time.

She is direct in the way that people who have run night shifts often are, and she has no patience for the word logistics when the word is trucks.

Hollowell took four months away from the company in 2022 while she recovered from a back injury she says was earned across two decades of loading docks, and she returned on a phased schedule the company has since offered to everyone.

Her stake in Lantern Freight is reported at just under nine per cent, which on the company last raise would be worth somewhere around four million dollars on paper, a number she calls imaginary until somebody buys it.

She would rather talk about the dispatch board, and does.
